verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Puzzle ships its own in-product AI features (Accounting AI, AI Close agents), and such features could plausibly consume external MCP servers. However, the evidence only shows Puzzle acting as an MCP server that Claude, ChatGPT or other assistants connect to. That is the opposite role and earns no credit for this client-side story, and nothing documents plugging third-party MCP servers into Puzzle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
